# World Nuclear News: Mega cooling tower completed at Chinese unit

Published: 19 Sep 2025.

## Key Findings
- **World's first nuclear power ultra-large high-level seawater cooling tower** completed at **Unit 1, Lianjiang plant, Guangdong province**.
- Announced by **State Power Investment Corp (SPIC)**.
- Final concrete for circular foundation poured **Nov 2023**. Foundation: >10m wide, >2m thick, ~15,900 m³ concrete.
- Tower: **height 218.7m**, **base diameter ~175m**, **137,400 m³ concrete** total.
- Water spraying area: **20,000 m²**.
- Components: foundation, inclined pillars, tower tube, inlet, central water shaft, water distribution, heat exchange filler, water collection, main tank, water eliminator.
- **"Secondary circulation cooling technology"** (vs traditional once-through cooling):
  - Replaces direct seawater extraction/discharge with **reuse of cooling water**.
  - Uses **atmosphere as ultimate heat sink** (air-water heat exchange).
  - **Water discharge reduced to 1/40th** of traditional nuclear plants.
  - Discharge temperature approaches natural seawater temperature.
  - Minimizes marine organism infestation risk.
- Lianjiang: first coastal nuclear project by SPIC in Guangdong.
- Phase 1: **two CAP1000 units** (1,250 MWe each, Chinese AP1000). Site eventually: **six reactors**.
- First nuclear plant in China to adopt seawater secondary circulation cooling + super-large cooling tower.
- Construction approved by State Council **Sep 2022**.
